snippet.title: Path of Exile 1: Covens of Umbra Trailer
snippet.description:
In Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra, disrupt dark magicks and put an end to the powerful witchcraft of the Coven Queen.

Our November expansion introduces a new challenge league, a set of fundamental changes to the endgame alongside improvements to existing endgame systems, new unique items, and more!

Play Path of Exile: Covens on Umbra for free on November 13 (PST) across all available platforms.

https://pathofexile.com/covens
